update_log: Baseline initialization of frequently tested scientific instruments and their practical applications for General Science Static GK.

weather_and_environment.measurement_use: Measures atmospheric pressure (sudden drop indicates a storm).
Measures the relative humidity or moisture content in the air.
Measures the amount of liquid precipitation over a set period.
Measures and records the intensity and duration of earthquakes.

medical_and_biology.measurement_use: Used to listen to internal sounds of the body, mainly the heart and lungs.
Records the electrical activity and rhythm of the heart.
Records the electrical activity of the brain.
Used to examine the interior of a hollow organ or cavity of the body.

physics_and_electrical.measurement_use: Measures the strength of an electric current (connected in series).
Measures the electric potential difference between two points (connected in parallel).
Detects and measures very small electric currents.
Measures extremely high temperatures (e.g., surface of the sun or furnaces) where thermometers melt.
Measures the quantity of heat in a chemical reaction or physical change.

navigation_mechanics_and_fluids.measurement_use: Measures the relative density of milk to determine its purity.
Measures the specific gravity (relative density) of liquids.
Measures altitude, used extensively in aircraft.
Measures the depth of the ocean.
Measures the working speed (RPM - revolutions per minute) of an engine or shaft.
Sound Navigation and Ranging; uses sound waves to detect underwater objects like submarines.
Radio Detection and Ranging; uses radio waves to detect the position and speed of flying objects like aircraft.
